newsitem.title: CYPRUS: Rating agency gives Fubon Taiwan stable outlook.
newsitem.headline: Rating agency gives Fubon Taiwan stable outlook.

text.p: Cyprus-based Capital Intelligence has given initial ratings of BB long-term and A-2 short-term for Fubon Commercial Bank of Taiwan, the specialist bank rating agency announced.
In its first rating on the Taiwan-based bank, Capital Intelligence said Fubon had a stable outlook.
The bank's capital position is strong, and it enjoys better liquidity than many of its peers.
However, said Capital Intelligence in a press release, its asset quality is below average, with an increasing incidence of non-performing loans and apparently inadequate provision coverage.
Profitability has been poor, largely as a result of competitive pressures on margins, a high cost base and a relatively low level of non-interest income.
Fubon was founded in 1991 by a group of businessmen. Its major shareholders include several prominent local corporates, such as the Evergreen Group and Chia Hsin Cement Company.
The bank's largest shareholder with 35 percent is the Fubon Group, Taiwan's leading financial conglomerate.
